en: Black‑and‑white wartime photograph showing three uniformed men standing in front of a railcar or ambulance wagon marked with a Red Cross symbol. The man on the left wears a German-style uniform and peaked cap, the central figure is in a darker coat with rank stripes on the cuffs and a side cap, and the man on the right wears a lighter greatcoat and an Adrian-style helmet. At the bottom of the image there is handwritten text identifying the three men, and beneath the image a printed credit in French to the Bibliothèque nationale et universitaire de Strasbourg.
